purpose: Tidy extracts of PJM RPM Base Residual Auction clearing prices and NITS zone rates, the two regulated $/MW-yr components behind the firm interconnection cost term c_F.

conventions.bra_price: $/MW-day UCAP resource clearing price at each pricing point; annualised by x365 for a $/MW-yr figure
conventions.nits: per transmission zone: annual revenue requirement (USD) and network integration transmission service rate
conventions.dom: 'DOM' is the Dominion zone pricing point, the data-centre-dense LDA referenced in the paper's discussion

caveats: BRA prices are auction outcomes, not a tariff; they clear at the administratively set cap in tight years.
NITS rates are recovered from load-serving entities in the zone; a large load's actual obligation also depends on its transmission service request and any zonal/network upgrade agreements.
